Kikimashta card review

The collection is visually cohesive; meaning and discrimination need the most work. Preserve the flat fills, rounded purple outlines and simple square framing. Fix the inaccurate hand, food cues, disappearing action arrow, ambiguous targets and overlapping answer concepts first.

Reviewed all 441 library cards plus the starter set: 445 unique entries, 170 active in practice. The two starter entries already in the library are counted once. The 269 existing library flags are recorded separately from added findings.

Start here: 手 · 米 · 入れる/出す · 小皿 · 毛 · 広げる; then 一つ/リンゴ, 牛肉/肉 and 文/作文 as unfair answer pairs. Also revise adult-dominant 子牛, envelope-dominant 切手, and small machine grids. Library-only cultural issues include altered flags and the green availability cue on 空車.

Stylistic variations worth tightening: whole-group scaling changes outline thickness; grouped objects become very small; 走る uses a different limb treatment. Most images read as one collection, including the starter SVGs. The retained historic watercolor JPEGs are not the current card art.

Review date: 5 November 2026 (local). Rendered image inspection and source matching, with selected closeups and roughly quiz-sized comparisons. No audio pronunciation review, real iPhone check or learner comprehension study. “No added finding” is a limited review result, not a claim of universal clarity. High/medium/low are editorial priorities.

Active practiceHigh · fix before use

一つ ひとつ

One Thing

ja-v-277587e6fa07 · Source level 1

F02 · interpretability 一つ shows one large apple, while the canonical starter リンゴ also shows one large apple. Both truthfully answer an apple prompt. They have different image paths/readings and can pass the current choice filter, creating an unfair picture-choice question.

Suggested change: Prevent semantically overlapping pictures from appearing together. Prefer count-only practice or a contextual counting prompt for counters; do not treat a different SVG path as a sufficient distinction.

F05 · interpretability the generic counters show counts of apples, while bare numbers show written digits. The image alone does not establish the grammatical distinction between a bare number and a counter. This is especially weak for one apple versus apple, and is a broader pedagogical collision rather than a drawing error.

Suggested change: Constrain distractors to fair number/count comparisons, explicitly introduce the picture convention, and move bare-number/counter distinctions into short noun-and-counter scenarios as exercises broaden.

F11 · style the collection is strongly cohesive overall, but scaling complete SVG groups scales strokes too. The giant single apple has a much heavier outline than the eight-apple grid, and individual people get much thinner outlines in group scenes. The apparent line system and character proportions vary with grouping.

Suggested change: Set target line weights for full-size subjects and grouped subjects; use non-scaling strokes where appropriate or normalize after scaling. Keep an explicit minimum detail/line threshold at quiz size.

文 ぶん

Writing

ja-v-d4fb59f8c32c · Source level 2

F04 · accuracy, interpretability the image is a pencil over generic lines on paper. The most immediate readings are writing, pencil, or document; it does not identify 文 as connected text/a sentence and overlaps 書く and 作文 elsewhere in the library. The English gloss Writing encourages the action reading.

Suggested change: Decide whether this card teaches sentence or written text, clarify the gloss, and show the product with one sentence highlighted. Use a contextual exercise or keep it outside picture-only practice if the distinction requires reading.

Sources: kids.gakken.co.jp

F35 · interpretability These active cards both depict a sheet with generic horizontal lines and a pencil. Their small layout changes do not communicate sentence/text versus composition. They are permitted to compete by the current image-path/reading filter.

Suggested change: Review 文 as sentence/text and 作文 as composition/written work. Teach these in short listening scenarios or exclude their pictures from each other’s distractors; swapping pencil angles will not establish the intended lexical distinction.

入れる いれる

To Insert

ja-v-b5e9e035a8be · Source level 5

F33 · accuracy, interpretability Both pictures show a solid orange cube with a closed top, although the concepts describe an open box. The orange downward arrowhead for 入れる lies over the orange top face and disappears; at quiz size only a vertical stem remains. 出す has a visible upward arrow but still lacks a visible container interior.

Suggested change: Draw an open box with a clear interior and front lip. Use a contrasting action arrow whose entire head remains visible, and show the ball crossing the opening in a before/after or motion sequence.

牛肉 ぎゅうにく

Beef

ja-v-5dc14aea92c7 · Source level 5

F34 · interpretability Both cards use the same distinctive steak shape. 牛肉 adds a small cow badge and 肉 adds a plate, but beef is also meat, so either picture can truthfully answer a 肉 prompt. Different image paths do not make these mutually exclusive.

Suggested change: Avoid pairing category words with their instances as competing answers. Teach 肉 with a varied meat grouping, teach 牛肉 with clear animal provenance, and use contextual listening to test the finer distinction.

ja-v-0958f7553d9f · Source level 5

皮肉 ひにく

Irony

ja-v-ebb68031a152 · Source level 5

F46 · interpretability The symbolic pictures have clear shapes but weak unique meanings: tree rings → originally, checked mirror → truth, praise plus mishap → sarcasm, weather bubble → maybe, majority dots → generally. Hitting a bullseye can mean success, accuracy or skill. These are associations a learner must memorize rather than literal depictions.

Suggested change: Use explicit listening context to establish the intended sense, or treat these as taught mnemonics. Do not promote them to picture-only practice just because the icon is clean.

Existing library review flag

Praise over an obvious mishap symbolizes irony or sarcasm; high ambiguity requires review.

空車 くうしゃ

Open Taxi

ja-v-a557e263cea4 · Source level 5

F41 · accuracy, interpretability The picture is a generic yellow taxi with a green roof lamp and a check. It does not clearly show an empty interior or a Japanese vacancy display. The concept specifically calls the green light available, which risks importing a misleading taxi-sign convention.

Suggested change: Show an empty passenger compartment and an accurate vacancy display for the chosen Japanese setting. For a Tokyo cue use the red 空車 display near the windscreen, rather than treating a green roof lamp as availability. Update Open Taxi to Vacant taxi.

Sources: www.taxi-tokyo.or.jp · www.tokyo-tc.or.jp

近年 きんねん

Recent Years

ja-v-f2e8d12a8234 · Source level 5

F43 · interpretability Calendar pages, numerals, arrows and question marks use different implicit conventions for month, day, year, recurrence and duration. For example 何月 is a single question-mark calendar and 何年 is four question marks with no year marker; 近日 and 来月 use the same two-page arrow motif. These are mnemonic diagrams, not independently readable scenarios.

Suggested change: Use one taught calendar/timeline system with a visible current point, clear day/month/year units and consistent span/recurrence markers. Prefer contextual listening when the distinction still depends on reading conventions.

Existing library review flag

Highlighted most recent years symbolize recent years; numerical dates are illustrative.

Original SVG files and application behavior were not changed. Notes distinguish direct visual defects, ambiguous teaching choices and existing context-dependent cards.
